第443章 温暖你身体（第1页）
“嗯。”唐婉清难为情的嗯了一声。
“你是不是很讨厌我？”柳大春想起一些事来，询问道。
“没有啊，为什么讨厌啊？”唐婉清不解道。
“以前啊，你从来不理我，不屑于我，高冷，清高，多看我一眼都不看，是吧。我又不可能忘的。”柳大春说起往事来。
“啊？我没什么印象啊。我比你大几岁，平时也不和你们玩啊，我和我的同龄人玩，至于你说的什么不理不屑，我压根就没当回事。”唐婉清解释道。
“就是我透明的。”柳大春苦笑，不然呢？还指望别人巴结着你吗？都喜欢你吗？
如果不是现在自己觉醒，估计还是和以前一样，被嘲讽，当傻子，捉弄，无视的存在。
唐婉清尴尬一笑，说道：“我真的没有注意你，所以谈不上讨厌。”
“追你的男生很多吧？”柳大春又问道。
“嗯，村里有十几个男生追求我吧。”唐婉清也不避讳的说道。
以唐婉清的这个G氖的身材，十几个男生追求算少的了。
“那看来我这样倮抱着你，是我占便宜了，他们可能做梦都羡慕死我吧，婉清姐姐这样的美女确实暴殄之物。”柳大春打趣着说道。
唐婉清被说得难为情，但寒冰发作的时候确实极其难受，生不如死的，仿佛全身每一个细胞浸泡在冰水中一样。
“嗯。”唐婉清也就哦了一声，不知道说什么。
和这样的美人酮体在一起，柳大春自然而然地有了感觉。
这种感觉一下子就让婉清捕捉到了，她更加难为情了。
心里想着：你是给我治病的啊，不是，那个？怎么能？

但想想，人家血气方刚的，这也确实是正常的反应啊。
柳大春故意按了按的臀部，把腿缠着更紧更贴合。
这样一来，柳大春的那也是完全的贴在唐婉清的那地方。
这让唐婉清瞬间脸红得一塌糊涂，心也是狂跳不止，停都停不下来，她也是尴尬死了。
“那应该没那么快缓过来，就继续多抱抱。”柳大春说道。
“嗯。”唐婉清红着脸，已经不敢看柳大春了。
而屋外，唐茹夜，男友徐志雷都很紧张，走来去的。
“你说婉清怎么样了？柳医生有没有在给治疗啊？”唐茹夜很着急。
“应该在治疗吧，我听说柳医生的医术大家都是夸赞的。”徐志雷回答道。
“你啊，还有我闺女，以前是不是欺负过柳大春？”唐茹夜现在想起来，不爽了。
“怎么没有？和那个赵钧一起，没少干坏事。现在知道用人家了？以后啊，你和婉清对大春可上心点。”唐茹夜批评道。
上一代的妇女，心地普遍还是善良的。
如果徐志雷知道，现在女友正和柳大春倮抱着，不知道会是什么感受了！！

Chapter 443 Warm your body (page 1)
"Yeah." Tang Wanqing hummed embarrassedly.
"Do you hate me very much?" Liu Dachun asked, remembering something.
"No, why do you hate it?" Tang Wanqing asked confused.
"In the past, you never ignored me or looked down upon me. You were aloof and aloof, and you didn't even look at me, right? I can't forget it." Liu Dachun talked about the past.
"Ah? I don't have any impression. I'm a few years older than you, and I don't usually play with you. I play with my peers. As for what you said about ignoring and disdain, I didn't take it seriously at all." Tang Wanqing explained.
"I am the one who is transparent." Liu Dachun smiled bitterly, otherwise? Do you still expect others to fawn over you? Do they all like you?
If he hadn't awakened now, he would probably still be the same as before, being ridiculed, treated as a fool, teased, and ignored.
Tang Wanqing smiled awkwardly and said, "I really didn't pay attention to you, so I can't say you're annoying."
"Are there many boys chasing you?" Liu Dachun asked again.
"Well, there must be a dozen boys in the village pursuing me." Tang Wanqing said without hesitation.
With Tang Wanqing's G-Neon figure, it was considered a small number for more than a dozen boys to pursue her.
"Then it seems that I am taking advantage of you by holding you like this. They may be envious of me even in their dreams. A beauty like Sister Wanqing is really a waste of money." Liu Dachun said jokingly.
Tang Wanqing was said to be embarrassed, but when the ice broke out, it was indeed extremely uncomfortable, as if life was worse than death, as if every cell in her body was soaked in ice water.
"Yeah." Tang Wanqing just said oh, not knowing what to say.
Being with such a beautiful woman, Liu Dachun naturally felt something.
This feeling was immediately captured by Wanqing, and she became even more embarrassed.
I thought to myself: You are here to treat me, aren’t you, that one? How could it be?
But think about it, this is indeed a normal reaction for such a hot-blooded person.
Liu Dachun deliberately pressed his buttocks, wrapping his legs tighter and more fitting.
In this way, Liu Dachun's position was completely attached to Tang Wanqing's position.
This made Tang Wanqing blush instantly and her heart was beating wildly and couldn't stop. She was also extremely embarrassed.
"Then it shouldn't come over so quickly, so just keep hugging me more." Liu Dachun said.
"Yeah." Tang Wanqing blushed and no longer dared to look at Liu Dachun.
Outside the house, Tang Ruye and her boyfriend Xu Zhilei were very nervous and walked back and forth.
"How do you think Wanqing is doing? Is Dr. Liu treating her?" Tang Ruye was very anxious.
"She should be undergoing treatment. I heard that Dr. Liu's medical skills are praised by everyone." Xu Zhilei replied.
"You, and my daughter, have you ever bullied Liu Dachun before?" Tang Ruye felt unhappy now that she thought about it.
"Why not? Together with that Zhao Jun, you have done a lot of bad things. Now you know how to use others? From now on, you and Wanqing should pay more attention to Dachun." Tang Ruye criticized.
Women of the previous generation were generally kind-hearted.
If Xu Zhilei knew that his girlfriend was hugging Liu Dachun now, I don't know how he would feel! !
